title: Stratum program-synthesis solver response (v1)
description: Output of the program-synthesis solver: the solved program as session/slot plans with set counts, calendar assignment, objective breakdown, and per-session structure. Produced by the solver (ProgramSynthesisWire.encodeResult shape), consumed by the Kotlin client. See solver-contract/VERSIONING.md for modelVersion semantics. This schema is the producer contract: CI validates solver output against it strictly. Decoders implement the separate lenient mode in VERSIONING.md §2 and MUST NOT validate inbound payloads against this raw schema.

modelVersion.description: Contract major version. The solver MUST emit it. Clients MUST tolerate a missing value (pre-versioned Kotlin solver results during rollout).

sessions.description: Resolved session plans, one per session position, in position order.

plans.description: Session slot plans with solver-assigned set counts, one per session position, in position order. Parallel to sessions.

cycleSlotIndexByPosition.description: Assigned cycle slot per session position, in position order.

activeSlotIdsBySession.description: Universe slot ids (e.g. "h-press") activated per session position, in position order. These are bare universe ids, NOT session-prefixed slot ids.

regionFilterBySession.description: Solver-chosen SessionRegionFilter per session position, in position order. This is the source of truth for session region structure; sessionType on sessions/plans is a legacy display label. Producers MUST emit it; decoders infer it from sessionType labels when missing (pre-field solvers).

slotRole.title: SlotRole
slotRole.description: Canonical v1 roles. Decoders ALSO accept the legacy wire alias "Isolation" (maps to Accessory); producers MUST emit canonical names only.

sessionTypeId.title: SessionTypeId
sessionTypeId.description: Legacy display label for the session. Structure truth is regionFilterBySession.

nullableSessionComposition.title: NullableSessionComposition
nullableSessionComposition.description: Session composition that may be null when unclassified.

slotTemplateBase.title: SlotTemplateBase
slotTemplateBase.description: Internal base: the 9 slot properties shared by workoutSlotTemplate and filledSlot. Intentionally open (no unevaluatedProperties) — always reference via the strict workoutSlotTemplate / filledSlot wrappers.

allowedFatigueProfiles.description: Fatigue allow-list for pattern-OR matching, or null for pattern match only. Decoders drop unknown names and treat an empty array as null; producers MUST emit null or a non-empty canonical array.

workoutSlotTemplate.title: WorkoutSlotTemplate
workoutSlotTemplate.description: Strict slot template: slotTemplateBase closed to additional properties.

filledSlot.title: FilledSlot
filledSlot.description: Slot template with the solver-assigned set count.

setCount.description: Solver-assigned working sets for this slot.

sessionPlanBase.title: SessionPlanBase
sessionPlanBase.description: Internal base: sessionType/name/slots/siblingIndex/position shared by resolvedSessionPlan and sessionSlotPlan. Intentionally open — always reference via the strict wrappers.

objectiveBreakdown.title: SynthesisObjectiveBreakdown
objectiveBreakdown.description: Solver objective value plus per-term penalties. All values are int64 solver units (weighted, scaled credits) — opaque to the client except for diagnostics.
